maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost spots are arranged in a 2:3 distribution (right:left) positioned approximately 1.5 to 2 spot-diameters superior to the primary dense vibrissae row, following a slightly arched horizontal trajectory relative to the upper lip line.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 98-100% melanin saturation; pixels on the apex and wings are uniformly dark with no visible pink or depigmented clusters.
